notes: Reconciled English 1.5.5 + owner-accepted 1.5.6 B–F exact UI translations; existing valid strings preserved, other languages deferred; 1.6-LW requires continual same-change translation audits.

strings.Може ли да ми кажеш повеќе за тоа?: Could you tell me more about that?
strings.Од атоми до твојот непознат жив свет: From atoms to your own living world
Find features quickly. Locked abilities show their requirements.
strings.Нема наплата, реклами ниту активна прода: No purchases, ads or active store.
Create a creature to start raising it.
The world and life are simulated.
strings.Стартот до првите клетки трае минути, по: First cells take only minutes. Later evolution requires progressively more time and resources. Lab actions also regenerate as time passes.
strings.Секој вид ги покажува сите предуслови. О: Every species lists its unlock requirements. From Synapso onward, you evolve an existing mature pet through DNA; advanced creatures are never created from nothing.
strings.Лабораториите продолжуваат со нови нивоа: Your laboratory keeps advancing beyond the first campaign. There is no final win screen.
strings.Секоја успешна експедиција отвора нова в: Each successful research expedition discovers a new food formula, plant, or habitat material.
strings.🔒 Истражувањето нова фауна бара лаборато: 🔒 Discovering new fauna requires lab level 12 and a selected Noetrium or successor at level 75+. Every new form still needs DNA evolution.
strings.Нема регистрирани изуми. Истражувај за д: No discoveries yet. Research to create your first formula.
strings.Прво достигни еволутивна фаза 7, а потоа: Reach evolution stage 7 to begin building a habitat.
strings.Управувај со квалитет, растенија, капаци: Manage habitat quality, plants, capacity and construction. Changes update the active habitat immediately.
strings.Потребна е еволутивна фаза 7. Изградбата: Evolution stage 7 is required. Construction takes time.
strings.Новите материјали од Истражувања го згол: Research materials expand your habitat and allow more plants.
strings.Формулите и специјализираните хранливи с: Unlock nutritional formulas through research. Food production does not use actions belonging to other pets.
Advanced creatures are never created from nothing. Transform a mature ancestor and retain its memory, age, skills and history.
strings.Секое милениче има свои акции, меморија,: Every pet has independent actions, memory, levels, transformations and training.
strings.Прво одгледај ќелија и изгради живеалишт: Grow a cell and build a habitat first.
strings.Вештините се отклучуваат постепено — пор: Skills unlock gradually. Advanced training can take months of evolution.
strings.Синапсо и следните видови добиваат мала: Synapso and later species may use a small real language model (135M parameters). Its package is separate from the APK and runs only during direct conversation.
strings.Мини модел, претежно англиски. Разговори: A tiny model, mostly English. Chat stays on your device; no server or background generation.
strings.Започни разговор со својот еволуиран мил: Start chatting with your evolved pet.
strings.Една лична акција по порака. Моделот се: One pet action per message. The model loads only for direct chat and releases memory afterward.
strings.Тука се звукот, резервните копии, извест: Sound, backups, notifications and developer tools belong here. The complete journal has its own menu.
strings.Избери јазик на интерфејсот. Имињата на: Choose the interface language. Pet names and older journal entries remain unchanged.
strings.За Android, датотеките се избираат преку: On Android, choose backup files through the system picker. No full-storage permission is required.
strings.Звучните сигнали и бројот на иконата зав: Notification sounds and icon badges depend on Android and your launcher settings.
strings.Опционална програмерска алатка. Дебаг-де: Optional developer controls. Skipped days are simulated in this local world; debugging is not enabled during normal play.
strings.⚠ Тестни измени во светот! Прво извези J: ⚠ Testing changes your world. Export a JSON backup first if you want to preserve progress.
strings.Секое животно има сопствени акции и раст: Every creature has its own actions and growing action limits.
strings.Без регистрација, без наши сервери, рекл: No accounts, game servers, ads or payments. Both phones need the game open. Some NAT/firewall combinations prevent connections without TURN.
strings.На твојот телефон притисни „Создај покан: Tap Create invitation on your phone and send the code as a message.
strings.Пријателот го внесува кодот и притиска „: Your friend enters the code, taps Accept and sends the response back.
strings.Допрете ги милениците во аквариумот; ког: Tap pets in the aquarium to interact when connected. Each pet can earn one social reward per friend per day.
strings.Сѐ уште немаш зачувани пријатели. Поврзи: You have no saved friends yet. Connect and tap Add.
strings.Грешката е пријавена во конзолата. Други: The error was logged in the console. Other menus remain available.
strings.Преминување на повисоки нивоа бара стекн: Higher lab levels require research, time, mature pets and controlled habitat chemistry. No shortcuts.
strings.Избери суштество во аквариумот. Секоја а: Select a creature in the aquarium. Each action uses one of its own daily actions and improves its symbolic vocabulary.
strings.Храната се произведува посебно. Универза: Food is produced separately. Universal meals suit everyone; specialized recipes provide extra nutrition to particular species.
strings.Само фантастични визуелни гени. Нема вис: Fantasy visual genes only. No real DNA, biology procedures or modification of real organisms.
Select a pet for DNA customization.
strings.Сликите се создаваат локално во PNG. За: Capture photos, short GIFs or supported videos locally. Media is shared only when you choose to share it.
strings.Започни од неживи атоми, создај клетка,: Start with lifeless atoms, grow cells, research multicellular organisms, build habitats and raise extraordinary creatures.
strings.Секое живеалиште има сопствено pH, кисло: Every habitat has its own pH, oxygen, temperature, mineral balance and limited capacity. Pets use more room as they grow.
strings.Секое суштество чини 22 биомаса и 8 моле: Each new creature costs 22 biomass and 8 molecules. There must be enough free habitat capacity.
strings.Растенијата не се готови декорации. Прво: Plants are not ready-made decorations. Discover each plant first, then grow it from resources in a compatible habitat.
strings.Пет последователни чекори со посебни мат: Five construction stages with individual material costs; at most one step daily. Habitats cannot be built instantly.
strings.Уште нема настани. Започни со синтеза на: No events yet. Start synthesizing molecules.
No pet selected in this habitat. Create your first pet in the lab.

strings.Избери автоматски системски јазик или ед: Choose the system language automatically or one of 17 available languages. Older untranslated text falls back to English; personal names and your journal stay unchanged.
strings.Можеш повторно да ги прочиташ упатствата: You can replay the introduction or tutorial any time without changing your progress.

strings.Се отклучува и за веќе развиен Мнемос: в: Also unlocks for existing evolved Mnemos: species Mnemos, level 165, laboratory 20.

strings.Модел не се презема пред согласност. Не: No model is downloaded without consent. It is never required for gameplay.
strings.Потребни се Wi-Fi, слободен простор и до: Requires network, free storage and sufficient RAM. Google/cloud is not required. The model loads only when you send a message.
Advanced models are only available on Android.
strings.Да овозможам локална AI меморија за овој: Enable on-device AI memory for Mnemos? Messages are saved in the world and JSON backup. Model download is separate and optional.
strings.Од неживи атоми ќе создаваш свој непозна: From lifeless atoms, you will create your own unknown living world. There is no quick victory — the game grows with you.
strings.Твоите организми ќе учат, растат и ќе се: Your organisms will learn, grow and transform. The world progresses over days, months and years.
strings.Следи ги петте градежни чекори, одржувај: Follow the five building steps, maintain chemical conditions and plant flora.
strings.Нахрани, играј и тренирај. Секој миленик: Feed, play and train. Every pet has its own age, skills, needs and evolution.
strings.Нови видови и ДНК-преобразби бараат науч: New species and DNA transformations require research, time and earned levels. Nothing needs to be purchased.

strings.Мини-моделот разговара само додека овој: The mini model talks only while this screen is visible. Without it, the playground continues normally. AI speech earns no XP.
strings.Мини AI по правило разговара додека екра: Mini AI normally talks while the screen is visible; with your permission it may continue in the background. Without a model, the game continues. AI speech earns no XP.
